About Us

We are bringing innovation to the dealing process across the globe by tackling some of today’s financial institutions’ challenges: automation, cost savings, integration, best execution, productivity, compliance, and conduct risks.  Our award-winning solutions bring the latest technology to traditionally voice-traded markets by optimizing the matching of interests on financing structures, equity derivatives, and interest rates.

Working at Wematch

Exceptional talent fuels every aspect of our organisation from the constantly evolving fintech we develop to the unrivaled client service, at the core of everything we do. 

We recently asked our Team to tell us the best thing about working at Wematch:

  • "The people"
  • "The friendly atmosphere, room for learning and growth, working flexibility."
  • "Wematch is like a big family across different countries”
  • “Everyone has the opportunity to progress inside the company”
  • “The work I do is recognised by everyone”
  • "A great place to learn, and a great place to share"
  • “The People are great the work is interesting”

Who We Hire

We’re not looking for job seekers, we want changemakers: we hire the best of the best from the financial technology industry. Whether you are a recent graduate, a working professional, or looking for an internship, you will dynamically contribute to our growing business. You will work with a Team who is as motivated and passionate as you are in an environment that promotes team, personal, and professional growth.

Diversity & Inclusion

We’re passionate about creating an inclusive workplace that promotes and values diversity. Companies that are diverse in age, gender identity, sexual orientation, physical or mental ability, and perspective are proven to be better companies. More importantly, we believe that creating an environment where everyone, from any background, can do their best work is the right thing to do.

The Wematch Talent Project

The Wematch Talent Project is a blog series spotlighting the diverse professionals who drive Wematch’s continued success. By sharing their stories, we offer a glimpse into our culture and values, forging a connection between our team and our audience, fostering appreciation, and inspiring all who engage with our community. 

Each instalment provides a unique perspective on those fueling our growth and evolution.
